#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
echo "system"
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
configure system id node-name name SANITIZED-ISAM
configure system security operator isadmin password encrypted:SanitizedHashOne prompt "%n%d%c "
configure system security operator noc password prompt prompt %n>
configure system security operator viewer password plain:******
configure system security operator ops password plain:OperatorLeakOne
configure system security operator ops2 password="plain:FusedLeakTwo"
configure system security operator ops3 password plain:"Quoted LeakThree"
configure system security password min-length 12 min-num-numeric-char 2 no mixed-case
configure system security snmp community CommunityLeakFour host-address 10.0.0.1/32 context base
configure system security snmp community CommunityLeakFive host-address 10.0.0.1/32 context base
configure system security snmp community public host-address 10.0.0.2/32
configure system security snmp notify-profile prof1 snmp-version v2c:CommunityLeakFour
configure system security snmp notify-profile prof3 snmp-version v3
configure system security snmp user snmpuser1 authentication md5:plain:AuthLeakSix privacy des:plain:PrivLeakSeven
configure system security snmp user snmpuser2 authentication sha1:encrypted:0xSanitizedHashTwo privacy aes-128:encrypted:0xSanitizedHashThree
configure system security radius auth-server R1 secret plain:RadiusLeakEight
configure system security ssh sftp-user sftp1 password "encrypted:SanitizedHashFour"
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
echo "access"
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
configure pppoe-client interface 1/1/1/1 client-id 1 username user1 password PppoeLeakNine
configure ntp ont 1/1/5/1/3 key NtpKeyLeakTen
configure ntp ont 1/1/5/1/4 key 100
configure future node md5-key Md5KeyLeakEleven key-type hmac
configure future node pass-word DashedLeakTwelve
configure future node secret-key SecretKeyLeakThirteen
configure equipment ont interface 1/1/5/1/3 sw-ver-pland auto log-auth-pwd plain:****** desc1 RadiusLeakEight
configure equipment ont interface 1/1/5/1/4 sw-ver-pland auto desc1 ref:OperatorLeakOne
configure vlan id 100 name public-internet mode residential-bridge
configure vlan id 200 name prompt-vlan mode residential-bridge
configure qos tca 1/1/5/1/3/1/1 queue 0 no tca-enable load-thresh 80
configure  bridge port 1/1/5/1/3/1/1   max-unicast-mac 5 pvid 100
configure alarm entry ground-key severity minor
configure xdsl line 1/1/3/1 service-profile 13 spectrum-profile 2 no admin-up
